messages:
michael: :rotating_light: Alert - spike in 500s on /v1/paging endpoints observed from canary (sdk v0.16.0). Failing pagination requests, customers reporting missing pages. I'm paginating test user and getting empty lists after page 2.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created (severity: high) by michael. Paging API errors - canary rollout.

maya: on it. I triggered the canary this morning (0.16.0) to roll out the new paging header behavior. rolling back to 0.15.2 across canary nodes now.

deploy-bot: Rollback started: reverting service/redwood-api from 0.16.0-canary -> 0.15.2 (3/3 canary hosts). ETA ~4m.

cheng: logs show: "ERROR pagination: invalid next_token format" coming from server-side decoder on requests with header X-Client-Paging: v2. Stacktrace points to decoder change in sdk-protocol.

michael: confirmed reproduction steps: curl against canary host with header X-Client-Paging: v2 returns 200 but items [] for page > 1. Without header returns expected pages. Likely contract change in SDK causing server to mis-handle continuation tokens.

maya: immediate mitigation: kill-switching feature flag sdk_paging_v2 for canary traffic and pausing rollout. toggling flag now.

sre-bot: Feature flag "sdk_paging_v2" set to OFF for canary by maya. Traffic should route to legacy paging handler.

cheng: quick patch idea: accept both new and legacy token formats in decoder for a safe fallback. I'll prepare a hotfix branch but prefer to keep rollback + flag off until we verify.

maya: customer-impact note: looks like ~4% of requests hit the canary and ~12 customers reported truncated results (search/dashboard paging). emailing CS now.

customer-success: we're drafting a proactive note to the 12 affected customers. ping if we need specifics (customer names: Acme, FleetOps, DynoHealth - preliminary).

michael: handoff - I'm stepping off in 25m, eva will take over post-handoff. eva please grab an incident brief and keep the rollback state until root cause confirmed.

eva: taking over. I'll monitor for residual 500s and validate no more paginated truncation on canary hosts. Can someone post the repro curl?

michael: repro: ```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Client-Paging: v2" \
  "https://canary.api.redwood.ai/v1/paging?limit=50&page=3"
# returns 200 with "items": [] but expected ~50 items
```

cheng: repro logs show the incoming token payload looks like base64 of JSON in v2 but server expected opaque string; decoder attempted JSON parse and threw, resulting in empty continuation -> early return. I'll open a PR to add a tolerant decode path + unit tests.

michael: customer impact estimate: 12 customers, some dashboards failing to load historic pages, severity: moderate -> high for those accounts. No data leak.

maya: plan: keep flag off, complete rollback, run integration tests on 0.15.2 to confirm behavior, then release a patched 0.16.1 that preserves backward compatibility. If patch not ready in 2 hours, we'll block further SDK releases and escalate to oncall lead.

eva: monitoring: setting alert to watch for paging error rate >0.5% across prod, paging 500s reverted to baseline on canary after rollback. I'll update #incidents if anything spikes.

incident-bot: INC-2026-042 status updated: mitigation in place (rollback + feature-flag kill). Assigned to eva for follow-up.

michael: adding notes to postmortem template: root cause = incompatible client contract change in SDK paging token format; contributing factors: insufficient canary test coverage for continuation token formats, missed backward-compatibility check.

maya: +1 on postmortem. Also recommend adding a gating integration test that runs legacy clients and new SDK against canary before rollouts.

eva: taking over handoff. I'll coordinate customer comms with CS and keep oncall looped. tagging @sre-bot to add this to next oncall rotation briefing.

sre-bot: Noted - will include INC-2026-042 summary in next oncall briefing.

michael: thanks team. leaving notes in ops-runbook and linking this thread.

maya: PR link (hotfix): https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/482 (draft). Do not merge until tests and cs sign-off.

eva: closing interim mitigation: keeping feature flag OFF and canary rolled back. Will reopen if residual issues observed.
